mapper.select: SELECT g.subject, g.user_id, u.display_name FROM user_google_identities g JOIN users u ON u.id = g.user_id WHERE g.subject = #{subject}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_google_identities (subject, user_id, email, created_at, last_signed_in_at) VALUES (#{subject}, #{userId}, #{email}, #{now}, #{now})
INSERT INTO members (space_id, user_id, role, status) VALUES (#{spaceId}, #{userId}, 'OWNER', 'ACTIVE')
